name: toggle-group
title: Toggle Group
description: Two connected rows of icon buttons: bold, italic and underline in one, and left, centre and right alignment in the other. Picking a style or alignment immediately changes the sample text in the card below.
use: Formatting or view options where several can apply at once while one alignment stays chosen.
avoid: The joined pills read as one control, so keep each strip short; the items are icons with no visible labels.
a11y: Arrow key navigation and a focus ring come from the primitive, but the icon-only items need aria-label props for a name. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark card holds one toolbar row of two joined icon-button strips split by a thin divider: bold, italic and underline, then three alignment icons. Chosen buttons sit in a grey fill, and below them a bold heading and a paragraph react to the choices.
behaves: Clicking a style button adds or removes that mark from the sample heading, while an alignment button moves the whole text block left, centre or right. The frames show italic being turned on and the text swinging from left to centre and then right.
customise: Groups take type single or multiple plus size and variant props, while each item carries a value and its icon as children; item styling lives in the classes.
weight: light: A few small buttons and simple class swaps; nothing animates at rest.
demo: Release notes, v2.4 heading with a note about offline drafts syncing on reconnect.
polishWhy: Clean toolbar and a convincing live text reflow; icon-only items rely on labels.
